mcat_description.short: A Toll Booth is a prefabricated, portable cabin structure installed at highway toll plazas, parking facilities, and weighbridge stations for vehicle fee collection and traffic monitoring. Sold as a complete ready-to-install unit, typically fabricated from MS steel frames with ACP, PUF sandwich panel, GI sheet, FRP, or WPC cladding.
mcat_description.long: Toll Booth cabins are factory-fabricated, single or double-lane operator shelters designed for permanent or semi-permanent installation at NHAI highway toll plazas, state highway toll nakas, parking lots, weighbridges, and private road entry points. Structural frames are built from Mild Steel (MS) or GI rectangular hollow sections, with wall cladding options including ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel), PUF sandwich panels, GI sheets, FRP, or WPC boards, and glazing using 5mm toughened glass for operator visibility. Cabins are supplied pre-fitted with electrical fixtures, sliding windows, insulated panels, and optional AC provisions, and are designed to comply with NHAI guidelines for single or double lane configurations. The product is sold per piece with full customisation on dimensions, material grade, colour, and fitments as per client-supplied drawings or NHAI-approved specifications.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Toll Booth' refers specifically to a prefabricated operator cabin structure installed at highway toll plazas, parking facilities, and weighbridge stations — not to the broader toll plaza infrastructure (canopy, lane marking, signage). The dominant commercial form is a factory-fabricated MS steel frame cabin with ACP external cladding, supplied as a complete unit with toughened glass windows, electrical provisions, and optional insulation; this is confirmed across multiple Indian manufacturer sites (Valisons, Kotharis, Texo Prefab, PBH Group). NHAI guidelines govern single and double lane configurations for national highway applications, and buyers — primarily NHAI contractors and toll plaza operators — typically supply their own approved drawings with manufacturers fabricating to spec. Material variants span MS, ACP, PUF sandwich panel, GI sheet, FRP, and WPC, with ACP and PUF being the most commercially prominent for highway use due to weather resistance and thermal insulation. The parking cashier booth and weighbridge cabin are closely adjacent sub-segments sharing the same product form and supply chain. Keyword data shows very low search volume on IndiaMART for this MCAT (top internal keyword 'acp tool booth cabin' at 5 pageviews), suggesting buyers in this category primarily transact through direct contractor networks and project tenders rather than organic search — consistent with the NHAI project-driven procurement model.
